entry_points.text: Tunables validate before update: intervals take decimal ms, batch refused under auto advice, booleans take truth spellings, advisor limits unsigned with positive target, mode takes two names and refreshes defaults.
Candidacy and search serve admission and lookup; pair driver handles protection, replacement and linkage; bounded driver uses caller budget while not freezing.

exports.text: Sharing candidacy reports whether a stable entry can accept further sharing, with future offset or current state.
Weak comparator orders two full pages via temporary local mappings released in reverse.
Merge admin covers mapping flags, whole-space enable and disable, madvise ranges, enrollment lifecycle, and mergeable and profit queries.

hazards.text: Exit can race teardown with busy if mapped and exiting check under lock; volatile clamps; long teardown paths yield.

Direct I/O can raise references with flush before check and restore on mismatch; exclusive must be shared first; leaf sameness rechecked under lock; huge aborts and descent accepts only anon non-device pages.

Stale entries can rebalance forcing restart; busy aborts cleanly; fork self-matches reject; cross-node needs enable; alloc failure dissolves sharing; plus folded cache, compare, freezer, feature, list and zone helpers.

invariants.text: Detach unlinks stable hashes under folio lock with counter updates, or erases age-zero unstable nodes; trailing lists detach then free; stable removal is busy if mapped; chains need every member; teardown walks roots and migration queue with yields.

Mass unmerge scans slots, breaks sharing in mergeable areas, retires exiting spaces and resets sequence; slot lookup derives container; checksum hashes a mapped page; protection installs read-only entries and replacement maps shared or zero pages after validation.

Single merge needs anon folio, nonblocking lock and large-folio split, then protects and promotes or replaces after content check; zero path needs zero mode; pair merge promotes first then shares second with rollback.

Trees partition per node by frame with unstable cleared at wrap; trackers carry masked address with markers, sequence and node; allocation reuses on match; append warns past maximum unless fork bypass; smart skip budgets by age.

Collisions promote entries to duplicate chains; choice prunes stale members, prefers capable larger counts, collapses singular chains and frees empty ones; search shortcuts forks, descends by compare with restart and diverts migrated folios.
Eligibility rejects mergeable areas and defers to compatibility; add marks and removal tears down sharing then clears; whole-space enable registers and marks, disable unmarks with restore on failure.
Frame-interval pruning discards in-range singletons and members, freeing emptied chains to signal rebalance and sweeping migration queue with yields, restarting from first root.

Cross-node and limit changes allow no-ops else need idle sharing with teardown or report busy; status reads emit decimals with lockless clamped volatile estimate and profit from sharing and zero savings minus overhead.

locks.text: Folio lock guards hash removal and stable unlink; single merge uses nonblocking attempt; table uses lockless middle read revalidated under leaf lock with flush before reference check and notifier window around updates.
Space read lock spans lookup, merge and scan with exiting check; write covers disable and deferred exit; global list uses spin guard; run, limit and offline changes serialize on thread mutex.

state_machines.text: Scan cycles spaces in order, refreshing unstable and pruning migrated entries at wrap, visiting mergeable regions for present anon pages; thread runs freezable at low priority, waits offline, bursts merges then sleeps or waits.

Run accepts bounded selections, does full unmerge with origin marking when requested and reverts to stopped on failure, waking thread when merging; offline marks, prunes notified range, then clears with wakeup.

Trackers move among stable, unstable with age zero or one, and detached; chains collapse when singular and free when empty; merge flows through stability gate and lookups to attach or pair-merge with split defer and dissolve on failure.

structs.text: Walk result carries folio with page and address using middle handler and read-locked traversal; controls collect in null-terminated table under ksm with cross-node entry only when multi-node configured.

Tracker carries flagged address, owner, hash and tree links, node, anon pointer, index, list link, space and checksum; stable entry carries tree link, list, length, migration link and timestamp; advisor offers none versus scan-time.
